array.string: unset WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET; setopt NULL_GLOB; /opt/homebrew/bin/wezterm cli --prefer-mux --no-auto-start list || { /bin/rm -f "$HOME/.local/share/wezterm"/sock* "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.github.wez.wezterm"/sock*; exec /opt/homebrew/bin/wezterm cli --prefer-mux list || true; }
